title: What really happens when you send money?

scenes.text: You tap send. Your money leaves. But what if the app crashes halfway?
First, the server checks that you really have enough money.
Then it opens a transaction. Every step must work, or none of them do.
It takes the money out of your balance, and writes a record in the history.
If anything fails here, it rolls back. Your balance goes back, as if nothing happened.
If everything works, it commits. Now the change is locked in, for good.
I built this in my own banking app. Comment VAULT, and I will show you how.
